text:
tara: FYI the Orion POC is stuck on user sync. SSO works but SCIM groups arrive with empty members. They need Dedicated pool access for load testing next Tue. Can we triage?
devon: Do we have a sample of the SCIM response and the SAML assertion? Sometimes proxies rewrite arrays.
tara: SCIM snippet they sent (trimmed):
```json
{
  "Resources": [
    {
      "displayName": "Platform",
      "members": "user1,user2"
    }
  ]
}
```
samir: That's a classic array-flattening proxy issue. Our connector expects members as an array. Ask them if there's a gateway or CASB that transforms JSON bodies.
tara: SAML NameID sample they shared: `<NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:emailAddress">alice@orion.example.com</NameID>` — so SAML mapping looks OK.
ops-bot: [notice] Temp API key issued: poc-orion-temp-48h (expires in 48h). Owner: devon.
netops: For Dedicated pool: provisioning estimate 3-4 business days after ticket plus VPC peering. If they need faster, we can offer hosted concurrency boost for 48h while Dedicated is queued.
ps-engineer: Quick mitigation: we can accept comma-separated members if the string contains an '@' pattern and split server-side as a one-off for the POC. Need product approval but doable.
devon: I'll ask customer for: 1) exact SCIM request/response pairs, 2) proxy/gateway contact, 3) whether they use IP allowlists (we can give egress IPs).
tara: Security asked if temp key is OK for their review. What should I tell them?
ops-bot: Security policy: temporary keys OK for POC with TTL <= 72h, explicit scope, audit logging enabled. Document key id and TTL in the questionnaire.
ps-engineer: I'll draft the note about the temporary transformation and add a statement that production requires proper multivalued group claims or full SCIM provisioning.
tara: Thanks. I'll relay the temp key and ask for proxy details and SCIM logs. Will update thread when they reply. :thumbsup:
